image_description: A side-profile view of a reddish-brown horse (sorrel/chestnut) standing in a grassy field with trees in the background. The horse has a light-colored mane and tail, and white markings (socks) on its lower legs.

The chest depth is substantial relative to the leg length, and the back line is straight and strong.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All four legs are visible, appearing slender and anatomically correct. Hooves are present and appear singular and structurally sound.
